agent_revisions_egress_scope.name: agent_revisions_egress_scope
agent_revisions_egress_scope.value:
NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'egress_plan') OR COALESCE(
        jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan') = 'object'
        AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan'->'execution'->>'namespaceId' = "occ"."agent_revisions"."namespace_id"
        AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan'->'execution'->>'agentId' = "occ"."agent_revisions"."agent_id"
        AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan'->'execution'->>'revisionId' = "occ"."agent_revisions"."id"
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan'->'routes') = 'array',
        false)

agent_revisions_execution_admission.name: agent_revisions_execution_admission
agent_revisions_execution_admission.value:
COALESCE(
        jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'execution_admission') = 'object'
        AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'execution_admission') ?& ARRAY['version', 'mode']
        AND (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'execution_admission') - 'version' - 'mode') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND (
          ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'execution_admission'->>'mode' = 'unprotected'
            AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{execution_admission,version}' = '2'::jsonb
            AND NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'egress_plan')
            AND NOT (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'harness_auth') ? 'protectedExecutionVersion'))
          OR ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'execution_admission'->>'mode' = 'protected'
            AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'egress_plan'
            AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{harness_auth,protectedExecutionVersion}'
              = "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{execution_admission,version}'
            AND (
                "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{execution_admission,version}' IN ('3','4','5','6','7')
                AND CASE WHEN "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{execution_admission,version}' = '7'
                  THEN "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{egress_plan,policyReductionVersion}' = '2'::jsonb
                  ELSE NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan' ? 'policyReductionVersion') OR
                    ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{execution_admission,version}' = '3' AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{egress_plan,policyReductionVersion}' = '1'::jsonb) END
                AND (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{execution_admission,version}') IN ('4','5','6','7'))
                  = (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan') ? 'repositoryGit')
                AND (NOT (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan') ? 'repositoryGit')
                  OR (jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'repository_credentials')='object'
                    AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{egress_plan,repositoryGit}' = "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'repository_credentials'))
                AND CASE WHEN "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{execution_admission,version}' = '5'
                    THEN "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{egress_plan,repositoryGitAuthorization}' = 'online-request'
                    WHEN "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{execution_admission,version}' = '6' THEN
                      "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{egress_plan,repositoryGitAuthorization}' = 'request-hook-observed'
                      AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{egress_plan,repositoryGit,bindings,0,profile}' = 'github-installation'
                      AND jsonb_array_length("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{egress_plan,repositoryGit,bindings}') = 1
                    ELSE NOT (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'egress_plan') ? 'repositoryGitAuthorization') END
                AND
                jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{egress_plan,driver}') = 'object'
                AND length("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{egress_plan,driver,id}') > 0
                AND length("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{egress_plan,driver,implementation}') > 0
                AND "occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{egress_plan,driver,configurationId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
              ))
        ), false)

agent_revisions_admitted_snapshot.name: agent_revisions_admitted_snapshot
agent_revisions_admitted_snapshot.value:
("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ?& ARRAY[
          'configuration_id', 'configuration_kind', 'configuration_generation',
          'draft_spec', 'harness', 'compute', 'harness_auth'
        ])
        AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"
          - 'configuration_id' - 'configuration_kind' - 'configuration_generation'
          - 'draft_spec' - 'harness' - 'compute' - 'sandbox_driver_id' - 'sandbox_policy'
          - 'secret_driver_id' - 'secret_bindings' - 'harness_auth' - 'credential_sources' - 'plugins'
          - 'plugin_approvers' - 'repository_credentials' - 'egress_plan' - 'execution_admission') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'configuration_id') = 'string'
        AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->>'configuration_id') ~ '^cfg_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'configuration_kind') = 'string'
        AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->>'configuration_kind') = 'agent'
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'configuration_generation') = 'number'
        AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->>'configuration_generation')::numeric
          BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
        AND mod(("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->>'configuration_generation')::numeric, 1) = 0
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'draft_spec') = 'object'
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'harness') = 'object'
        AND (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'harness') ?& ARRAY['id', 'version', 'mode'])
        AND (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'harness') - 'id' - 'version' - 'mode') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{harness,id}') = 'string'
        AND COALESCE(btrim("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{harness,id}'), '') <> ''
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{harness,version}') = 'string'
        AND COALESCE(btrim("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{harness,version}'), '') <> ''
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{harness,mode}') = 'string'
        AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{harness,mode}') IN ('embedded', 'dedicated')
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'compute') = 'object'
        AND (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'compute') ?& ARRAY['id', 'implementation'])
        AND (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'compute') - 'id' - 'implementation' - 'admission') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{compute,id}') = 'string'
        AND COALESCE(btrim("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{compute,id}'), '') <> ''
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{compute,implementation}') = 'string'
        AND COALESCE(btrim("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{compute,implementation}'), '') <> ''
        AND (
          NOT (("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'compute') ? 'admission')
          OR (jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #> '{compute,admission}') = 'string'
              AND char_length("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{compute,admission}') BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
              AND ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" #>> '{compute,admission}') ~ '^[ -~]+$')
        )
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'sandbox_driver_id')
          OR (
            jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'sandbox_driver_id') = 'string'
            AND COALESCE(btrim("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->>'sandbox_driver_id'), '') <> ''
          )
        )
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'secret_driver_id')
          OR (
            jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'secret_driver_id') = 'string'
            AND COALESCE(btrim("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->>'secret_driver_id'), '') <> ''
          )
        )
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'secret_bindings')
          OR occ.secret_bindings_are_valid("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'secret_bindings', "occ"."agent_revisions"."namespace_id")
        )
        AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'harness_auth') = 'object' THEN
          occ.harness_auth_is_valid(("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'harness_auth') - 'protectedExecutionVersion', "occ"."agent_revisions"."namespace_id", true)
        ELSE false END
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'repository_credentials')
          OR occ.repository_credentials_are_valid("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'repository_credentials')
        )
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'plugins')
          OR jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'plugins') = 'object'
        )
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'plugin_approvers')
          OR (jsonb_typeof("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'plugin_approvers') = 'array'
            AND jsonb_array_length("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'plugin_approvers') <= 64)
        )
        AND (
          NOT ("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec" ? 'credential_sources')
          OR occ.credential_source_snapshots_are_valid("occ"."agent_revisions"."admitted_spec"->'credential_sources')
        )

        OR "occ"."agents"."harness_auth"->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM 'credential_source'

agents_backend_id_valid.name: agents_backend_id_valid
agents_backend_id_valid.value: "occ"."agents"."backend_id" IS NULL OR (char_length("occ"."agents"."backend_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "occ"."agents"."backend_id" = btrim("occ"."agents"."backend_id") AND "occ"."agents"."backend_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

controller_work_revision_requires_agent.name: controller_work_revision_requires_agent
controller_work_revision_requires_agent.value: "occ"."controller_work"."revision_id" IS NULL OR "occ"."controller_work"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL

controller_work_namespace_target_valid.name: controller_work_namespace_target_valid
controller_work_namespace_target_valid.value:
(
        ("occ"."controller_work"."work_kind" = 'lifecycle' AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."revision_id" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."namespace_target" IS NOT NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."namespace_target" IN ('ready', 'deleted')
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" IS NULL)
        OR ("occ"."controller_work"."work_kind" = 'lifecycle' AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."revision_id" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."namespace_target" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" IS NOT NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" IN ('stopped', 'deleted', 'sandbox_policy'))
        OR ("occ"."controller_work"."work_kind" = 'lifecycle' AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."namespace_target" IS NULL
          AND ("occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" IS NULL OR "occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" = 'credentials_withdrawn'))
        OR ("occ"."controller_work"."work_kind" = 'provisioning' AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_id" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."revision_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."namespace_target" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" IS NULL)
        OR ("occ"."controller_work"."work_kind" = 'lifecycle' AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_id" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."revision_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."namespace_target" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."agent_target" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."idempotency_key" ~ '^agent_revision:rev_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}:repository_cleanup:(retire:)?[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      )

controller_work_claim_state.name: controller_work_claim_state
controller_work_claim_state.value:
(
        ("occ"."controller_work"."state" = 'claimed'
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("occ"."controller_work"."state" <> 'claimed'
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "occ"."controller_work"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)
      )

controller_work_completion_state.name: controller_work_completion_state
controller_work_completion_state.value:
(
        ("occ"."controller_work"."state" IN ('succeeded', 'failed_permanent')
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("occ"."controller_work"."state" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed_permanent')
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."completed_at" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."reason_code" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."controller_work"."result_data" IS NULL)
      )

controller_work_result_data_state.name: controller_work_result_data_state
controller_work_result_data_state.value:
"occ"."controller_work"."result_data" IS NULL OR (
        jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data") = 'object'
        AND (
          (
            "occ"."controller_work"."state" = 'failed_permanent'
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."reason_code" IN ('HARNESS_CREDENTIAL_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED', 'HARNESS_CREDENTIAL_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT')
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" - 'preparation') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND occ.compute_preparation_failure_is_valid("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'preparation')
          )
          OR
          (
            "occ"."controller_work"."state" = 'failed_permanent'
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."reason_code" = 'CONVERGENCE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED'
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."result_data" ? 'timeoutMs'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" - 'timeoutMs' - 'runtimeFailure') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'timeoutMs') = 'number'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->>'timeoutMs') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->>'timeoutMs')::numeric <= 9007199254740991
            AND (
              NOT ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" ? 'runtimeFailure')
              OR (
                jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') = 'object'
                AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') ?& ARRAY['component', 'check', 'checkedAt', 'code']
                AND (("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') - 'component' - 'check' - 'checkedAt' - 'code') = '{}'::jsonb
                AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,component}') = 'string'
                AND char_length("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,component}') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
                AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,component}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~:@-]{1,64}$'
                AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,check}') = 'string'
                AND char_length("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,check}') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
                AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,check}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~:@-]{1,64}$'
                AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,checkedAt}') = 'string'
                AND occ.iso_timestamp_is_valid("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,checkedAt}')
                AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,code}') = 'string'
                AND char_length("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,code}') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
                AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,code}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~:@-]{1,64}$'
              )
            )
          )
          OR (
            "occ"."controller_work"."state" = 'failed_permanent'
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."reason_code" = 'RUNTIME_MODEL_PROBE_FAILED'
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."result_data" ? 'runtimeFailure'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" - 'runtimeFailure') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') = 'object'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') ?& ARRAY['component', 'check', 'checkedAt', 'code']
            AND (("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') - 'component' - 'check' - 'checkedAt' - 'code' - 'cause') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,component}') = 'string'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,component}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~:@-]{1,64}$'
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,check}') = 'string'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,check}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~:@-]{1,64}$'
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,checkedAt}') = 'string'
            AND occ.iso_timestamp_is_valid("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,checkedAt}')
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,code}') = 'string'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,code}') = 'MODEL_PROBE_FAILED'
            AND (
              NOT (("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'runtimeFailure') ? 'cause')
              OR (
                jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,cause}') = 'object'
                AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,cause}') ? 'kind'
                AND (("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,cause}') - 'kind' - 'detail') = '{}'::jsonb
                AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,cause,kind}') = 'string'
                AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,cause,kind}') IN ('PROCESS_EXIT', 'PROBE_STATUS', 'INVALID_OUTPUT', 'WRAPPER_ERROR')
                AND (
                  NOT (("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,cause}') ? 'detail')
                  OR (
                    jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #> '{runtimeFailure,cause,detail}') = 'string'
                    AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" #>> '{runtimeFailure,cause,detail}') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$'
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
          OR (
            "occ"."controller_work"."state" = 'succeeded'
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."reason_code" IN ('REVISION_ACTIVATED', 'REVISION_ALREADY_ACTIVE')
            AND "occ"."controller_work"."result_data" ? 'warnings'
            AND ("occ"."controller_work"."result_data" - 'warnings') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."controller_work"."result_data"->'warnings') = 'array'
            AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(
              "occ"."controller_work"."result_data",
              '$.warnings[*] ? (@.type() != "object" || !(exists(@.code)) || !(exists(@.pluginId)) || @.code.type() != "string" || @.pluginId.type() != "string" || !(@.code == "PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED" || @.code == "PLUGIN_AUTH_REQUIRED") || !(@.pluginId like_regex "^[A-Za-z0-9._~:@-]{1,253}$"))'
            )
            AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(
              "occ"."controller_work"."result_data",
              '$.warnings[*].keyvalue() ? (@.key != "code" && @.key != "pluginId")'
            )
          )
        )
      )

credential_deliveries_rotation_target_ch.name: credential_deliveries_rotation_target_check
credential_deliveries_rotation_target_ch.value: "occ"."credential_deliveries"."write_pending" IS DISTINCT FROM 'rotate' OR "occ"."credential_deliveries"."target_material_version" IS NOT NULL

generated.as: CASE WHEN policy_request IS NULL THEN binding_id END

credential_delivery_reductions_policy_ch.name: credential_delivery_reductions_policy_check
credential_delivery_reductions_policy_ch.value:
CASE WHEN "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request" IS NULL THEN
      "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."recipient" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."material_version" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."retained_policy_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_observed" IS NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(
      "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."recipient" IS NULL AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."material_version" IS NULL AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."retained_policy_hash" IS NULL
      AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request"->>'version' IN ('1','2')
      AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request"->>'operationId' = "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."request_id"::text
      AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request" #>> '{expected,plan,execution,revisionId}' = "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."revision_id"
      AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request" #>> '{expected,plan,generation}' = "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."expected_version"
      AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request" #> '{retained,routes}') = 'array'
      AND ("occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_observed" IS NULL OR (
        "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_observed"->'plan' = "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_request"->'retained'
        AND "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."policy_observed" #>> '{plan,generation}' = "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."observed_generation")), false) END

credential_delivery_reductions_check1.name: credential_delivery_reductions_check1
credential_delivery_reductions_check1.value: "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."observed_generation" IS NULL OR "occ"."credential_delivery_reductions"."request_id" IS NOT NULL

credential_sources_egress_valid.name: credential_sources_egress_valid
credential_sources_egress_valid.value:
CASE WHEN "occ"."credential_sources"."type" = 'credential-free-repository-metadata' THEN
      "occ"."credential_sources"."config"->'authority' = '"execution"'::jsonb
      AND "occ"."credential_sources"."config"->'agent_id' = "occ"."credential_sources"."egress" #> '{grant,isolationId}' AND "occ"."credential_sources"."config"->'origin' = "occ"."credential_sources"."egress"->'origin'
      AND "occ"."credential_sources"."config"->'repository_id' = "occ"."credential_sources"."egress" #> '{grant,repositoryId}' AND "occ"."credential_sources"."config"->'repository' = "occ"."credential_sources"."egress" #> '{grant,repository}'
      AND occ.credential_free_metadata_source_is_valid("occ"."credential_sources"."egress", "occ"."credential_sources"."namespace_id", "occ"."credential_sources"."id")
    ELSE "occ"."credential_sources"."egress" IS NULL OR occ.egress_source_is_valid("occ"."credential_sources"."egress", "occ"."credential_sources"."namespace_id", "occ"."credential_sources"."id") END IS TRUE

credential_withdrawals_last_attempt.name: credential_withdrawals_last_attempt
credential_withdrawals_last_attempt.value: ("occ"."credential_withdrawals"."last_reason" IS NULL) = ("occ"."credential_withdrawals"."last_attempt_at" IS NULL) AND ("occ"."credential_withdrawals"."last_reason" IS NULL OR "occ"."credential_withdrawals"."last_reason" ~ '^[A-Z0-9_]{1,64}$')

egress_send_receipts_check_8.name: egress_send_receipts_check_8
egress_send_receipts_check_8.value:
(binding->'sender'->>'id' = sender_id
      AND (binding->'sender'->>'generation')::bigint = sender_generation
      AND binding->>'instanceId' = instance_id
      AND binding->>'useId' = use_id AND binding->>'attemptId' = attempt_id
      AND length(binding->>'deadlineAt') > 0
      AND jsonb_typeof(binding->'material') IN ('object', 'null')) IS TRUE

egress_send_receipts_check_9.name: egress_send_receipts_check_9
egress_send_receipts_check_9.value:
(
    (outcome->>'kind' = 'refused' AND outcome->'dispatched' = 'false'::jsonb AND settled)
    OR (outcome->>'kind' IN ('response', 'provider_rejected', 'response_blocked')
        AND outcome->>'dispatch' = 'confirmed' AND settled)
    OR (outcome->>'kind' = 'uncertain' AND outcome->>'dispatch' = 'possible')
  ) IS TRUE

egress_send_receipts_check_10.name: egress_send_receipts_check_10
egress_send_receipts_check_10.value: outcome->>'kind' <> 'provider_rejected' OR feedback IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'fenced'

egress_send_receipts_check_12.name: egress_send_receipts_check_12
egress_send_receipts_check_12.value:
outcome->>'kind' NOT IN ('response', 'provider_rejected')
    OR ((outcome->>'status')::integer BETWEEN 100 AND 599) IS TRUE

egress_send_receipts_check_13.name: egress_send_receipts_check_13
egress_send_receipts_check_13.value:
observation IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(observation) = 'object'
    AND observation->>'kind' IN ('response', 'provider_rejected', 'response_blocked')
    AND observation->>'dispatch' = 'confirmed'
    AND CASE WHEN observation->>'kind' = 'response_blocked'
      THEN observation->>'code' = 'response_policy'
      ELSE (observation->>'status')::integer BETWEEN 100 AND 599 END) IS TRUE

egress_send_receipts_check_14.name: egress_send_receipts_check_14
egress_send_receipts_check_14.value: observation->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'provider_rejected' OR feedback IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'fenced'

egress_send_receipts_check_15.name: egress_send_receipts_check_15
egress_send_receipts_check_15.value: observation IS NULL OR NOT settled OR outcome = observation OR outcome->>'kind' = 'uncertain'

egress_send_receipts_check_16.name: egress_send_receipts_check_16
egress_send_receipts_check_16.value:
feedback IS NULL OR ((observation IS NOT NULL OR (settled AND outcome->>'dispatch' = 'confirmed'))
    AND occ.egress_receipt_material_is_valid(binding->'material')) IS TRUE

egress_send_receipts_check_17.name: egress_send_receipts_check_17
egress_send_receipts_check_17.value:
authorized_dispatch IS NULL OR (
    jsonb_typeof(authorized_dispatch) = 'object'
    AND authorized_dispatch #>> '{association,installation,instanceId}' = instance_id
    AND authorized_dispatch #>> '{association,execution,installationId}' = binding #>> '{material,source,installationId}'
    AND (authorized_dispatch->>'sendStartBy')::timestamptz > (authorized_dispatch->>'authorizedAt')::timestamptz
    AND (authorized_dispatch->>'sendStartBy')::timestamptz <= (authorized_dispatch->>'authorizedAt')::timestamptz + interval '1 second'
    AND (authorized_dispatch->>'sendStartBy')::timestamptz <= (binding->>'deadlineAt')::timestamptz
    AND CASE WHEN binding #>> '{material,kind}' = 'no_material_required' THEN
      (binding->'material') - ARRAY['kind','source','binding','grantHash','isolationId'] = '{}'::jsonb
      AND binding #>> '{material,grantHash}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND occ.egress_ref_is_valid(binding #> '{material,binding}')
      AND binding #> '{material,source,provider}' = '{"id":"credential-free-repository-metadata","generation":1}'::jsonb
      AND occ.egress_ref_is_valid(binding #> '{material,source,source}') AND occ.egress_ref_is_valid(binding #> '{material,source,backend}')
      AND binding #>> '{material,source,namespaceId}' = authorized_dispatch #>> '{association,execution,namespaceId}'
      AND occ.prepared_github_dispatch_matches(authorized_dispatch, binding->'material')
      AND authorized_dispatch->>'injectionDigest' = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
    ELSE occ.egress_receipt_material_is_valid(binding->'material')
      AND (binding #>> '{material,kind}' = 'static' OR occ.prepared_github_dispatch_matches(authorized_dispatch, binding->'material'))
      AND (authorized_dispatch->>'sendStartBy')::timestamptz <= (binding #>> '{material,usableUntil}')::timestamptz
      AND length(authorized_dispatch #>> '{association,exchangeId}') > 0 AND length(authorized_dispatch #>> '{association,responseId}') > 0
      AND length(authorized_dispatch #>> '{association,custodyId}') > 0 AND length(authorized_dispatch->>'requestDigest') = 64
      AND length(authorized_dispatch->>'injectionDigest') = 64
    END) IS TRUE

iam_identities_kind_ownership.name: iam_identities_kind_ownership
iam_identities_kind_ownership.value:
(
        ("occ"."iam_identities"."kind" = 'principal'
          AND "occ"."iam_identities"."namespace_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."iam_identities"."agent_id" IS NULL
          AND "occ"."iam_identities"."issuer" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."iam_identities"."subject" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("occ"."iam_identities"."kind" = 'service_principal'
          AND ("occ"."iam_identities"."agent_id" IS NULL OR "occ"."iam_identities"."namespace_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND "occ"."iam_identities"."issuer" IS NULL AND "occ"."iam_identities"."subject" IS NULL)
      )

iam_restrictions_resource_id_normalized.name: iam_restrictions_resource_id_normalized
iam_restrictions_resource_id_normalized.value: "occ"."iam_restrictions"."resource_id" IS NULL OR ("occ"."iam_restrictions"."resource_id" = btrim("occ"."iam_restrictions"."resource_id") AND char_length("occ"."iam_restrictions"."resource_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

namespaces_existing_namespace_unique.name: namespaces_existing_namespace_unique
namespaces_existing_namespace_unique.where: "occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."namespaces"."deleted_at" IS NULL

namespaces_existing_namespace_valid.name: namespaces_existing_namespace_valid
namespaces_existing_namespace_valid.value:
"occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace" IS NULL OR (
        char_length("occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace") BETWEEN 1 AND 63
        AND "occ"."namespaces"."existing_namespace" ~ '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$'
      )

prepared_github_attempts_not_issued_chec.name: prepared_github_attempts_not_issued_check
prepared_github_attempts_not_issued_chec.value: custody <> 'not_issued' OR (state = 'quarantined' AND material_version IS NULL)

prepared_github_attempts_expired_check.name: prepared_github_attempts_expired_check
prepared_github_attempts_expired_check.value:
custody <> 'expired' OR (state = 'committed' AND material_version IS NOT NULL
        AND isfinite(usable_until) AND isfinite(provider_expires_at)
        AND usable_until < provider_expires_at) IS TRUE

prepared_github_attempts_check.name: prepared_github_attempts_check
prepared_github_attempts_check.value:
custody <> 'current' OR (state = 'committed' AND sealed IS NOT NULL
    AND material_version IS NOT NULL AND usable_until IS NOT NULL
    AND provider_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND usable_until <= provider_expires_at)

prepared_github_families_check.name: prepared_github_families_check
prepared_github_families_check.value:
(source #>> '{key,source,id}' = source_id AND (
  (source->>'adoption' = 'prepared' AND source #>> '{grant,profile}' = 'metadata-read'
   AND admission->>'familyId' = source_id AND jsonb_typeof(issuer->'backendRef') = 'object')
  OR
  (
   (((source->>'adoption' = 'prepared_repository_git' OR (
       source->>'adoption' = 'credential_proxy_repository_git'
       AND jsonb_typeof(source #> '{session,credentialProxyExecution,driver}') = 'object'))
   AND ((source #>> '{grant,profile}' = 'git-ref-write' AND NOT (source->'grant' ? 'pullRequestBase'))
       OR (source #>> '{grant,profile}' = 'git-ref-draft-pr' AND length(source #>> '{grant,pullRequestBase}') > 0))
   AND source #>> '{grant,pushRef}' LIKE 'refs/heads/%'
   AND source #>> '{grant,repositoryId}' = source #>> '{session,grant,repositoryId}')
   OR (source->>'adoption' = 'credential_proxy_github_repository'
       AND jsonb_typeof(source #> '{session,credentialProxyExecution,driver}') = 'object'
       AND source #>> '{session,credentialProxyExecution,enforcement,repositoryGitRecipient,deliveryProfile}' = 'github_repository'
       AND source #>> '{session,binding,profile}' = 'github-repository'
       AND source #>> '{grant,profile}' = 'github-repository'
       AND jsonb_typeof(source #> '{grant,repositories}') = 'array'
       AND jsonb_array_length(source #> '{grant,repositories}') BETWEEN 1 AND 16
       AND jsonb_typeof(source #> '{grant,permissions}') = 'object'
       AND source #>> '{grant,permissions,metadata}' = 'read'
       AND jsonb_typeof(source #> '{session,bindings}') = 'array'
       AND jsonb_array_length(source #> '{session,bindings}') = jsonb_array_length(source #> '{grant,repositories}')
       AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(source, '$.session.bindings[*] ? (@.profile != "github-repository")')
       AND jsonb_path_query_array(source, '$.session.bindings[*].grant.repositoryId') @> jsonb_path_query_array(source, '$.grant.repositories[*].repositoryId')
       AND jsonb_path_query_array(source, '$.grant.repositories[*].repositoryId') @> jsonb_path_query_array(source, '$.session.bindings[*].grant.repositoryId')
       AND source #>> '{grant,appId}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
       AND source #>> '{grant,installationId}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$')
   OR (source->>'adoption' = 'credential_proxy_github_installation'
       AND jsonb_typeof(source #> '{session,credentialProxyExecution,driver}') = 'object'
       AND source #>> '{session,credentialProxyExecution,enforcement,repositoryGitRecipient,deliveryProfile}' = 'github_installation'
       AND source #>> '{session,binding,profile}' = 'github-installation'
       AND source #>> '{grant,profile}' = 'github-installation'
       AND (source->'grant') - ARRAY['id','isolationId','appId','installationId','profile'] = '{}'::jsonb
       AND source #>> '{grant,appId}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
       AND source #>> '{grant,installationId}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
       AND source #>> '{session,grant,repositoryId}' = 'github-installation:' || (source #>> '{grant,installationId}'))
   )
   AND source_id = 'repository-git:' || (source #>> '{session,admissionId}')
   AND admission->>'familyId' = source_id AND admission->'grant' = source->'grant'
   AND source #>> '{grant,id}' = source #>> '{session,grant,grantId}'
   AND source #>> '{grant,isolationId}' = source #>> '{session,revisionId}'
   AND issuer = '{"kind":"worker-mounted-github-app-key"}'::jsonb)
)) IS TRUE

prepared_repository_git_uses_operation_c.name: prepared_repository_git_uses_operation_check
prepared_repository_git_uses_operation_c.value:
("occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."operation" IN ('advertise-upload-pack','upload-pack','advertise-receive-pack','receive-pack')
        OR ("occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."recipient_fence" IS NULL AND "occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."operation" = 'create-draft-pull')
        OR ("occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."recipient_fence" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."operation" IN ('github-rest','github-graphql')))
      AND ("occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."recipient_fence" IS NULL OR "occ"."prepared_repository_git_uses"."recipient_fence" > 0)

repository_broker_receipts_state_valid.name: repository_broker_receipts_state_valid
repository_broker_receipts_state_valid.value:
("occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."state" = 'fenced' AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."session_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."deadline_wall_ms" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."revoked" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."expired" IS NULL)
      OR ("occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."state" = 'reserved' AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."generation" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."session_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."deadline_wall_ms" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."revoked" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."expired" IS NULL)
      OR ("occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."state" = 'active' AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."generation" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."deadline_wall_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."deadline_wall_ms" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."revoked" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."expired" IS NULL)
      OR ("occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."state" = 'disposed' AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."generation" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."deadline_wall_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."deadline_wall_ms" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."revoked" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."revoked" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."expired" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_broker_receipts"."expired" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

repository_session_succession_fields.name: repository_session_succession_fields
repository_session_succession_fields.value:
("occ"."repository_session_attempts"."predecessor_admission_id" IS NULL AND "occ"."repository_session_attempts"."execution_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR
      ("occ"."repository_session_attempts"."predecessor_admission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_session_attempts"."execution_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "occ"."repository_session_attempts"."execution_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

repository_session_attempts_phase_sessio.name: repository_session_attempts_phase_session_valid
repository_session_attempts_phase_sessio.value:
("occ"."repository_session_attempts"."phase" = 'opening' AND "occ"."repository_session_attempts"."session_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("occ"."repository_session_attempts"."phase" IN ('open', 'disposed') AND "occ"."repository_session_attempts"."session_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "occ"."repository_session_attempts"."phase" IN ('closing', 'invalidated')

secrets_backend_key_valid.name: secrets_backend_key_valid
secrets_backend_key_valid.value:
char_length("occ"."secrets"."backend_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 253
        AND "occ"."secrets"."backend_key" ~ '^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
        AND "occ"."secrets"."backend_key" NOT IN ('.', '..')

service_account_driver_bindings_external.name: service_account_driver_bindings_external_credential_id_valid
service_account_driver_bindings_external.value: "occ"."service_account_driver_bindings"."external_credential_id" IS NULL OR (char_length("occ"."service_account_driver_bindings"."external_credential_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "occ"."service_account_driver_bindings"."external_credential_id" = btrim("occ"."service_account_driver_bindings"."external_credential_id"))

service_accounts_credential_valid.name: service_accounts_credential_valid
service_accounts_credential_valid.value:
"occ"."service_accounts"."credential" IS NULL OR (
        jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential") = 'object'
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" ?& ARRAY['kind', 'secretRef'])
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" - 'kind' - 'secretRef') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'kind') = 'string'
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->>'kind') IN ('api_key', 'oauth_access_token', 'access_token')
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'secretRef') = 'object'
        AND (("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'secretRef') ?& ARRAY['name', 'key'])
        AND (("occ"."service_accounts"."credential"->'secretRef') - 'name' - 'key') = '{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #> '{secretRef,name}') = 'string'
        AND char_length("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,name}') BETWEEN 1 AND 253
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,name}') ~ '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*$'
        AND jsonb_typeof("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #> '{secretRef,key}') = 'string'
        AND char_length("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,key}') BETWEEN 1 AND 253
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,key}') ~ '^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
        AND ("occ"."service_accounts"."credential" #>> '{secretRef,key}') NOT IN ('.', '..')
      )
